name: Snake's Loop
source:
This game is made for black and white game jam. A little story about a snake who needs to find an oasis, but something goes wrong.

[From [url=https://sheldnet.itch.io/snakes-loop]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
本作是为黑白主题游戏创作活动制作的。故事很短，讲述一条寻找绿洲的蛇，却在途中遭遇了意外。

[摘自[url=https://sheldnet.itch.io/snakes-loop]itch.io[/url]]
